questions.question: Eight people, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only three people sit to the right of A. Only one person sits between A and B. Only four people sit between B and D. F sits to the immediate right of D. C is neither an immediate neighbour of B nor D. E sits second to the right of G. How many people sit between H and A?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Given: **Eight people, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only three people sit to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e505bda2a36ffa1123a3e721527d651dc2bae5b45dfcb7b37ebc809e36a3aa2.png] 

2) Only one person sits between A and B

3) Only four people sit between B and D. F sits to the immediate right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be13e4367c13a3c768e4ae04371d38324cd50aa6f826781088a37c7d0c6ed6fe.png] 

5) C is neither an immediate neighbour of B nor D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccaba53f7b1f779bff993fe89a6f07ff964fd379a3a03d039de4ced272f2fa03.png] 

6) E sits second to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/108ff7517d3fcfe1d835f9634140fd1e22085871f53c1b475cff69488d75fa60.png] 

7) H sits in the vacant place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c81915ba4a5d595c3b805e7770c1e982e4a3f289cc5241d8925b6bbe6d7bb53.png] 

Clearly, three person are sit between H and A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Three".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, the word 'FORM' is numerically coded as 25. The word 'SUIT' is numerically coded as 96 . How is the word 'RING' numerically coded in the same code language?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

Step 1 - Addition of the place value of the alphabet.

Step 2 - Interchange the digit we get after addition.

'FORM' is coded as 25

⇒F(6) + O(15) + R(18) + M(13) = 52

⇒52 After interchange the digit = 25 

and,

'SUIT' is coded as 96

⇒S(19) + U(21) + I(9) + T(20) = 69 

⇒69 After interchange the digit = 96

Similarly, 

'RING' is coded as '?'

⇒R(18) + I(9) + N(14) + G(7) = 48

⇒48 After interchange the digit = 84

Hence the correct answer is **"84".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

4 ∶ 30 ∶∶ 7 ∶ ? ∶∶ 6 ∶ 56
questions.solution: Logic: (1st number + 1) × (1st number + 2) = 2nd number. Now, For, 4 ∶ 30 ⇒ (4 + 1) × (4+ 2) ⇒ 5 × 6 = 30

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Bat ∶ Cricket ∶∶ Racquet ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: Logic: The second word is a sport in which the first word is used as equipment.

Here, Bat : Cricket → A bat is used in the sport cricket.

Similarly, Racquet : ? → A racquet is used in the sport of tennis.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Tennis".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
Golf: Golf is a sport, but it does not use a racquet. Instead, it uses clubs for players to hit balls into a series of holes.

 
 
• 
 
Baseball: Although Baseball uses a bat-like tool, it's not a 'racquet'. Racquets have netted/meshed centers which Baseball bats do not possess.

 
 
• 
 
Hockey: Hockey uses a stick rather than a racquet. The stick is used to hit or control a puck or ball.

questions.question: Ten friends went to a restaurant to have their lunch and sat in two parallel rows facing each other, such that five members are sitting in each row. K, L, M, N, O are sitting in Row 1 facing north, while persons F, G, H, I, J in Row 2 face south. N is facing the neighbour of J. Two persons sit between J and H. I sits in the middle of the line. G does not sit at any of the corners; G is neither facing M nor K. K sits to the left of M but not immediate left. J is the immediate neighbour of the person who is sitting at the corner. N does not sit at any of the corners. L is sitting second to the left of N. How many persons are sitting between J and G?
questions.solution:
1. Two persons sit between J and H, so there is two possibilities.

2. J is the immediate neighbour of the person who is sitting at the corner. 

3. N is facing the neighbour of J. N does not sit at any of the corners.

4. L is sitting second to the left of N. I sits in the middle of the line. 

5. G does not sit at any of the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fec280e9f804ca008b27f639fbb636826fa55e7f9b1fc19d6d0b7714a3191021.png] 

6. K sits to the left of M but not immediate left. G is neither facing M nor K. Case II will be eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cbb217e4b46a28aeca111404a3190d29a37d18b43126b6301dd15335715b297.png] 

Therefore, the final arrangement will be

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dbd561c874518676048023673533443cd77324f80174548d3cd488feec6bb5e.png] 

One** **persons are sitting between J and G.
